title: Knowledge Graph
description: Deterministic knowledge-graph contract (F059): the repository's knowledge corpus as a three-layer, four-verb graph shared by `amber knowledge graph --json` and the web knowledge surface. The graph is a pure function of the committed tree: stable order, no absolute paths, byte-identical on recompute. Every node and edge carries provenance; this deterministic layer emits only "deterministic" — "inferred" is reserved for the read-time LLM layer, which is never persisted.

schemaVersion.description: Graph schema version. Bumped on breaking shape changes (ADR-0012).

nodes.description: Graph nodes in stable id order. Code files are not nodes; artifacts enter at identity granularity.

id.description: Kind-prefixed node id, unique across the graph.

layer.description: Three-layer ontology: decision (adr, artifact), knowledge (wiki, memory, architecture), implementation (feature).

updated.description: Content-recorded date (ADR Date line, wiki frontmatter) — never a scan-time clock.

sourcePath.description: Repo-relative source of the node (POSIX separators).

paths.description: Declared anchors (a node property, never a ghost edge).

contextPage.description: Context page id merged into its source node as a property (ADR-0009).

revisions.description: Committed revision count for artifact nodes.

edges.description: Directed declarer -> declared edges in stable (src, verb, dst) order. Exactly four verbs.

evidence.description: Where the declaring document names the target.

drift.description: Dead-anchor findings attached to the declaring node, in stable (nodeId, path) order.

path.description: The declared anchor path absent from the tree.

actualPath.description: Detected actual path when a rename or directory collapse is recognized.
